sourceRelease: Natural Earth v5.1.2 + U.S. Census Bureau 2026 TIGER/Line primary and secondary roads; derived coarse grid, not a routable road inventory
license: Natural Earth: public domain. U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line: U.S. government work, freely reproducible; TIGER/Line is a registered trademark of the U.S. Census Bureau.
attribution: Made with Natural Earth and U.S. Census Bureau 2026 TIGER/Line data. Geo Planner has modified and repackaged Census data into a coarse travel model. This product is not an official Census Bureau product; the Census Bureau has not reviewed or endorsed these estimates.
roadCostModel: Road geometry between cell-visit midpoints plus straight connectors to one quantized road anchor per cell, at the road's assumed class speed; origin/overland access at 25 km/h; road times rounded up to 0.1 second
shoreModel: Representatives on retained generalized land in mixed cells; bidirectional 25 km/h shore links along continuous land; input access follows land or explicit retained road-visit geometry at 25 km/h; v2 road anchors, road times, land mask and speeds unchanged
attachmentModel: Input-cell source visit owning the unchanged road anchor; local access to checked land points at 25 km/h plus quantized source-polyline distance to the anchor at its existing road class speed, rounded up to 0.1 second; v3 graph and legacy shore access unchanged
augmentationModel: All contiguous-US state partitions plus DC processed with exact direction-independent geometry/class deduplication; partition links share unchanged canonical grid anchors with paid continuous-land transfers at 25 km/h and source arcs at assumed class speeds. Interpolated midpoint arcs retain source bends with a geodesic chord lower bound. Natural Earth roads, masks, shores and owner visits retained. No turn/access/grade topology inference or driving accuracy qualification. Packed visits retain all quantized bends; NAD83 treated as approximate geographic degrees. Nationwide v5 coarse model; travel-time accuracy remains unvalidated.
